jobDescription.description: Looking for an experienced Full Stack Developer skilled in React and Node.js to build and maintain scalable web applications, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and optimize application performance.

Strong understanding of REST APIs and databases
Experience with Git and version control workflows

Strong CSS and responsive design skills
